PLAN "12-Week Strength & Ski Return (Post-Meniscus)"
TYPE workout
VISIBILITY public

GOALS
  GOAL primary strength:
    name "Strength and safe return to skiing"

PHASES
  PHASE "Phase 1: Foundation" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Monday training 45m "Upper Body Strength":
        warmup:
          cycling 5m
        main straight_sets:
          bench_press 3x8..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          lat_pulldown 3x10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          dumbbell_row 3x10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          shoulder_press 3x10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          bicep_curl 2x12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          tricep_pushdown 2x12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 2m
          shoulder_stretch 2m
      DAY Wednesday training 45m "Lower Body & Core (Low Impact)":
        warmup:
          cycling 5m
        main straight_sets:
          leg_press 3x10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          glute_bridge 3x12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          step_up 3x10 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          calf_raise 3x15 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          plank 3x30s rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
          bird_dog 3x12 rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          hamstring_stretch 2m
          quad_stretch 2m
